description: This Java class manages timer notifications for an Android wearable app, handling actions like showing timer completion, deleting, and restarting timers, and creating notifications.

classes.name: TimerNotificationService
classes.description: Service class that manages notifications related to the timer, including showing, deleting, and restarting timer notifications.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents to perform actions like show, delete, or restart timer.

methods.name: restartAlarm
methods.description: Restarts the timer by launching SetTimerActivity.

methods.name: deleteTimer
methods.description: Deletes the current timer and cancels associated notifications.

methods.name: showTimerDoneNotification
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating the timer has finished, with an action to restart.
